title: Gross Rent as a Percentage of Household Income in the Past 12 Months
product: American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-year detailed estimates; Puerto Rico Community Survey for Puerto Rico
geography: All ACS summary level 050 counties and county equivalents in the 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico, using Census geography for this edition.

derivations.computed: E001 minus E011, equivalent to the sum of E002–E010 for every full-sample county estimate.
derivations.burden30: Sum E007, E008, E009 and E010. These categories represent gross rent of at least 30 percent of household income.
derivations.burden50: E010: gross rent of at least 50 percent of household income.
derivations.share30/share50: 100 times the matching count divided by computed. Zero denominators are unavailable.
derivations.sourceMoes: Published 90% margins of error for the original 11 count estimates, in housing units. CSV retains the source integer values.
derivations.share30Moe/share50Moe: Derived 90% margins in percentage points, using Census successive difference replication. Recompute each percentage for all 80 replicates, then multiply the square root of (4/80) times the sum of squared deviations from the full-sample percentage by 1.645. Keep signed replicate counts. A replicate denominator of zero contributes a replicate percentage of zero, following Census guidance.
derivations.boundaryModel: For a full-sample share of zero or 100, or an uncontrolled zero replicate variance, use Census VRE guide equations 4 and 5 with the state average weight: p*=min(0.5,2.3*weight/computed); MOE=100*1.645*sqrt(p*(1-p)*weight/computed), with p=p*. Both share MOE method fields identify the method used.

geographicKey: Five-digit state and county FIPS, stored as text. Municipalities and county-equivalent areas retain Census names.
reference: Estimates describe a pooled five-year period. Count totals, all nine rent-ratio categories, the published not-computed category and all eleven original margins were reconciled against the county variance replicate release.
csvFields: geoid, name, state, state_name, period; B25070_E### and B25070_M### are source count estimates and margins. Computed counts, percentages and MOEs follow as named derived fields.
